description.en: Two-stage informed consent for EMR: discussion of the procedure, alternatives, recurrence risk, individualised complication estimates, anticoagulant management, prophylactic antibiotics, and post-procedure surveillance plans.

criteria.en: Discusses basic procedure and consent under supervision.
Independently conducts a two-stage consent discussion covering all aspects in Rec 10 sub-items; tailors to patient comorbidity and centre data.
Teaches communication skills; manages consent for complex/high-risk cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE EMR recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The recommendation is what ESGE publishes; the competency is what Evideris uses to score a trainee on. Not enumerated as objects in Tate EMR 2023; this competency frame is Evideris's design.
